"""Model of a test that selects product source through stored line numbers."""

from pathlib import Path

REGISTRY = Path("src/comet/domain_registry.py")
MODE_LINES = {"inventory": 1160, "writer": 1187}


def registry_lines() -> list[str]:
    """Return the registry source lines."""
    return REGISTRY.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()


def test_node_local_inventory_binds_modes_to_writer_expressions() -> None:
    """Require each inventory mode to select the recorded writer expression."""
    lines = registry_lines()
    for mode, stored_line in MODE_LINES.items():
        expression = lines[stored_line - 1].strip()
        assert mode in expression
